steps.en: Install it on a laptop, VPS or cloud VM
steps.zh: 装到笔记本、VPS 或云主机上

steps.en: Pick the LLM provider and model
steps.zh: 选好大模型厂商和模型

steps.en: Talk to it in the terminal, or start the gateway and message it from chat apps
steps.zh: 在终端里跟它聊，或启动网关后从聊天软件发消息

steps.en: Does the work with its tools in the configured terminal backend
steps.zh: 在配置好的终端后端里调用工具把活干完

steps.en: After a novel task, saves a skill and notes what it learned about you
steps.zh: 解决新问题后存成技能，并记下关于你的要点

steps.en: Next session, loads those notes and reuses matching skills and past sessions
steps.zh: 下次会话载入这些笔记，复用对得上的技能和旧对话

value.en: You stop re-explaining your setup and re-pasting the same procedure every conversation
value.zh: 不用每次对话都重新交代环境、重新粘贴同一套操作步骤

sources: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent#getting-started (hermes, hermes model, hermes gateway; CLI vs Messaging: hermes gateway start)
https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/main/website/docs/user-guide/features/memory.md (MEMORY.md / USER.md in ~/.hermes/memories, loaded at session start)
